visualCharacteristics.structure: image + optional text overlay (eyebrow, H1, description, CTA); text row empty on article pages
visualCharacteristics.notes: Full-width image-only banner at the top of article pages, directly above columns-article-header. Small (default): ~310px tall on desktop, object-fit cover, short 2880x600 crop. Option large: ~750px tall. Dark top gradient overlay keeps the code-rendered breadcrumb readable. LCP image: loaded eagerly with fetchpriority high. Topic/index pages (e.g. /news, /community, /news/news-releases) carry the H1 in the text row: then the block gets class has-text, the text is rendered as a white overlay with a dark left gradient and the banner grows with its text (min-height = the fixed height).

contentPattern: row 1: [image (required) with alt text]; row 2: [optional rich text: empty on article pages; on topic/index pages optional eyebrow p, H1, description p(s), optional CTA link p]. Option large via block class.
reuseGuidance: Use for the photo banner at the top of banner-content pages (text row empty) and of topic/index pages (text row carries eyebrow, H1, description, CTA from source section.topicHeader). Choose Large only when the source banner is not the short (header-small / articleHeader-small) crop.
